acts.title: The Renaissance Palace
acts.description: Gliding across Lake Como aboard a wooden Riva yacht toward the grand 16th-century facade.
acts.fact: 💡 HIGHLIGHT: 1568 ARISTOCRATIC PALACE ON LAKE COMO

acts.title: Baroque Cypress Allee
acts.description: Strolling through 25 acres of historic cypress groves and cascading stone nymphaeum fountains.
acts.fact: 💡 GARDENS: 25 ACRES OF CENTURY-OLD BOTANICAL SPLENDOR

acts.title: The Cardinal's Legacy
acts.description: Admiring gilded fresco ceilings, Como silk draperies, and authentic neoclassical oil paintings.

acts.title: The Floating Pool
acts.description: Floating in the legendary heated pontoon pool resting directly on the sapphire lake surface.
acts.fact: 💡 SIGNATURE: WORLD-FAMOUS LAKE COMO FLOATING POOL

acts.title: Lakeview Botanical Spa
acts.description: Restorative herbal therapies infused with Italian sweet orange, rosewater, and thermal minerals.

acts.title: Veranda Sunset Bellini
acts.description: Sunset champagne toast on the lakeside terrace as classical piano music drifts across the water.
acts.fact: 💡 SUNSET: GOLDEN TWILIGHT OVER THE CERNOBBIO SHORE
